# DEFAULT_DEFINITION_LIMITS

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The default [`DefinitionLimits`](definition-limits.md) applied when reading an untrusted definition.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core/definition`.

## Properties

- [`arrayLength`](#arraylength): Maximum length of any array (default 100,000).
- [`chartDataPoints`](#chartdatapoints): Maximum number of chart data points in the whole document (default 100,000).
- [`elementDepth`](#elementdepth): Maximum element nesting depth (default 32).
- [`elementNodes`](#elementnodes): Maximum number of elements in the whole document (default 50,000).
- [`inputBytes`](#inputbytes): Maximum size of the input, in bytes (default 16 MiB).
- [`jsonDepth`](#jsondepth): Maximum JSON nesting depth (default 64).
- [`pages`](#pages): Maximum number of pages (default 5,000).
- [`resourceBytes`](#resourcebytes): Maximum decoded size of a single resource (default 32 MiB).
- [`resourceBytesTotal`](#resourcebytestotal): Maximum decoded size of all resources together (default 128 MiB).
- [`stringLength`](#stringlength): Maximum length of any string value (default 1 MiB).
